newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL downgrades Pal-Peugeot to "D".
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL downgrades Pal-Peugeot to "D".

text.p: Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Wednesday that the "C" rating assigned to PAL-Peugeot Limited's (PPL) 1.42-billion- rupee non-convertible debenture programme has been cut to "D".
CRISIL said the revised rating indicated that the debentures were in default and in arrears of interest or principal payments or were expected to default on maturity.
"Such debentures are extremely spculative and returns from these debentures may be realized only on reorganisation or liquidation," it said.
"The company has defaulted on the scheduled semi-annual interest payment on the rated instrument which fell due on June 30, 1997."

It said that although Automobiles Peugeot, as one of the promoters, had earlier stated its intention to bring in the entire 920 million rupees into PPL and increase its current 32-percent stake to 48 percent, the other promoter, Premier Automobiles Ltd. (PAL), has not agreed to the expansion of the company's equity base.
PAL-Peugeot has declared a 680-million-rupee loss for the six-month period ending March 31, 1997.
